en.headline: Uber launches first Asia-Pacific Elite premium service with Kwoon Chung
en.dek: The partnership offers pre-booked Mercedes-Benz S-Class and V-Class rides with uniformed chauffeurs, targeting business travellers and making Hong Kong the first market outside the United States to introduce the service.
body: Uber has partnered with non-franchised bus operator Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings to launch Uber Elite in Hong Kong, the first Asia-Pacific market and only the second worldwide after the United States to offer the premium chauffeur service.

Passengers can book through the Uber app up to 90 days in advance or as late as two hours before pickup. Vehicles are Mercedes-Benz S-Class and V-Class models seating up to six, operated under valid hire-car permits held by Kwoon Chung. Drivers are full-time Kwoon Chung staff who wear uniforms, speak Cantonese, Mandarin and English, and complete a six-hour training course covering safety, service standards and app operations. Airport meet-and-greet is available, with extended waiting times of up to 60 minutes for airport trips.

Uber Hong Kong general manager Estyn Chung said the service responds to demand from business customers for a premium option. Kwoon Chung executive director Timothy Wong Cheuk-tim said the initial fleet comprises dozens of vehicles, with numbers adjustable according to demand. A promotional 50 per cent discount on first rides, capped at HK$2,000, runs until 31 August.

zh.headline: Uber聯乘冠忠推Elite尊尚服務 成亞太首個市場
zh.dek: 乘客可經App預約平治S及V-Class豪華車，司機穿制服並完成培訓，服務涵蓋機場接送，香港為美國以外首個推出地點。
body: Uber周一宣布與冠忠巴士集團合作，在香港推出尊尚接送服務Uber Elite，成為亞太區首個市場，亦是繼美國洛杉磯及三藩市後全球第二個推出地點。
乘客可透過Uber App最長提前90日或最遲出發前兩小時預約，車隊為持有效出租汽車許可證的平治S-Class及V-Class，最多可載六人。司機全屬冠忠全職員工，須穿制服，能以粵語、普通話及英語溝通，並完成六小時專業培訓及考核。服務設機場迎賓，機場行程可延長等候時間至60分鐘。
Uber香港總經理鍾志霆表示，服務回應商務客戶對尊尚出行的需求；冠忠執行董事黃焯添指首階段投入數十輛車，日後會按需求調整。即日起至8月31日，首次乘搭可享五折優惠，最高減2,000港元。
